criteria.description: For authored artifacts, follow template metadata, slug, Inputs and shared validation. For clarification/proposal outcomes, preserve target files until authorized creation or editing.

anchors.2: All applicable structure checks pass, or an appropriate clarification/proposal leaves the target unchanged.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Fix template metadata, links or required shared handoffs.

criteria.description: The resulting skill addresses the user purpose and separates adjacent tasks.

anchors.0: Wrong task or omitted core workflow.
anchors.1: Core task present with material ambiguity.
anchors.2: Inputs, outputs, scope and completion criteria support the actual requested capability.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Sharpen the intended outcome, boundaries and completion criteria.

criteria.description: Original relevant sources inform an original synthesis with verified attribution.

anchors.0: Fabricated evidence or copied unsupported instructions.
anchors.1: Sources exist but the combined analysis or attribution is incomplete.
anchors.2: Inspected original sources have useful adopted/rejected analysis and accurate attribution.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Inspect relevant source bodies and explain meaningful contributions.

criteria.description: User naming, edit approval and existing work are preserved.

anchors.0: Guessed naming, unapproved edits or destructive changes occur.
anchors.1: Boundaries stated but required evidence of compliance is absent.
anchors.2: Supplied name and specific approvals are honored, with unrelated work preserved.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Restore user naming and approval boundaries before further edits.

criteria.description: Shared evaluation packages, map and research lifecycle are integrated without duplicate validation.

anchors.0: Shared evaluation omitted or research promoted/deleted without approval.
anchors.1: Integration is partial or claims unexecuted tests passed.
anchors.2: Map and packages are correctly linked, shared validation owns final judgment, and evidence limits are accurate.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Complete evaluation/map integration and distinguish setup from executed evidence.

criteria.description: Instructions are concise enough to use and include non-obvious decisions.

anchors.0: Generic or contradictory guidance prevents use.
anchors.1: Useful guidance contains material duplication or an unclear pointer.
anchors.2: Focused workflow and selective references expose the right decisions when needed.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Prune duplicate guidance and clarify retrieval conditions.

scope_policy: Judge the stage requested in input, not unrequested later stages. A design specifies the required protocol without claiming execution; an assessment or clarification completes its own requested obligations. For actual performed work require observed evidence, and never infer a pass from a promise.
